haikus.haiku:
Orange peel soft glows
Cool swirl meets sweet sun on hand
Taste melts in summer
Happy #NationalCreamsicleDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Wooden balls roll bright
Lanes shine smooth as ice in sun
Pins dance with a *clack*
Happy #NationalBowlingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft fireflies glow
Candles flicker, scent of pine
Songs rise like warm mist
#HappyBirthdayDavidCrosby from @ClamBakeSanta
